title: C¹ cover of a countably n-rectifiable set (Simon 3.1.2, only if)
statement: Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ∈ ℕ and M ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} be countably n-rectifiable (Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M). Then there are N₀ ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with Hⁿ(N₀) = 0 and sets N_j (j ∈ ℕ), each an n-dimensional C¹ submanifold (IsC1Submanifold n) with Hⁿ(N_j) < ∞, such that M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃_j N_j (Hⁿ = μHE[n]).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (M : Set (Amb n ℓ)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (N : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ j, IsC1Submanifold n (N j) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (N j) < ∞) ∧ M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ j, N j
